other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: The method's practical example is applied to an industrial end-user whose profile is non-ferrous metals casting (a primary-metals / foundry context, though casting is not stated to be continuous-flow)
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
It is presented the application of the new energy analysis 
method in case of an industrial End-User with an energy 
consumption of over 1000 TEP/year, having as a profile the 
casting of non-ferrous metals.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Mention of a continuous production process consuming energy (productive vs unproductive consumption of the deployment of the production process)
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The Productive Energy Consumption is that part of the 
Energy Consumption used for the deployment of the 
production process.

one_line: The paper proposes and applies a new energy-efficiency/energy-effectiveness analysis method (adapting ODEX indicators) to an industrial end-user engaged in non-ferrous metals casting, analyzing electricity and natural gas consumption over two years.
